messages:
amanda: heads up — we want to add a small set of 'delta' runtime metrics to the main infra dashboard for routing/quota visibility. need to align on exporters + aggregation/retention before we flip anything. cc @ravi @kenji

ravi: +1. what are the exact metrics? will they be high-cardinality? that affects exporter approach and agg windows.

amanda: initial list: route_assign_latency_p50/p95, route_reject_rate, quota_exhaust_count, routing_fallback_rate. low-cardinality by design (route, region, env). the tricky one is per-customer quota_exhaust_count — could be high if we emit per-tenant.

kenji: per-tenant counters explode if we emit every request. can we emit sampled or only on transition events? e.g., emit when a tenant moves from healthy->exhausted, not every token.

amanda: yes that's the plan: emit transitions + periodic summary. for dashboards we only need 1m and 5m aggregates. we do want 30d retention for trending + rollout regressions.

liz: dashboard/UX note: for rollouts we want canary slices and ability to pivot between model/routing variant and tenant. If we don't keep 30d, we lose weekly baselines. 30d retention sounds right. also prefer pre-aggregated 1m and 5m to keep dashboard queries cheap.

marco: cost note: 30d at 1m granularity for route x tenant will be heavy. if cardinality limited to (route, region, env) it's fine. we need to decide: full per-tenant for 7d, aggregated for 30d? backfill cost estimate will be around ~8-12 GPU hours if we re-run exported logs for 30 days depending on sample.

ravi: proposal: exporters emit two series per metric: an event stream (transitions, sampled) routed to short-term high-card backend (7d, high-card) and a rolled-up series (1m/5m) to long-term store (30d, low-card). that splits cost and keeps dashboards responsive.

kenji: implementation detail: we can add a flag `metrics.delta_mode` to runtime config. pseudocode in the daemon: ```json
{
  "emit_transition_only": true,
  "sample_rate": 0.01,
  "rollup_windows": [60, 300]
}``` will let infra flip behavior per pool.

amanda: nice — can we also add a tag `backfill_ok=true/false` so ops knows which tenants to include when we do a historical backfill?

telemetry-bot: checklist created: "delta-metrics onboarding" => tasks: add exporter flag, aggregation job, dashboard panels, backfill plan, cost sign-off. Assignee: amanda (owner).

marco: for backfill: if we need 30d of per-tenant, we should limit to customers flagged for debugging. for org-wide trends run aggregated backfill only. estimate: aggregated backfill 2-3h, per-tenant selective backfill 10-15h.

liz: dashboard panels — mockups: 1) overall routing health (route_p95, fallback_rate) 2) quota-exhaust per region (heatmap) 3) per-tenant quick selector (only for flagged tenants). I'll put PNGs in the dashboard PR.

ravi: small API debate: should the internal metrics endpoint be /v1/internal/metrics or /internal/metrics/v1 ? we prefer stable pathing for long-lived exporters. leaning /v1/internal/metrics.

kenji: +1 for /v1/internal/metrics. also add a version header so we can change payload shape without changing path.

amanda: action items (summary): 1) kenji: add `metrics.delta_mode` flag + exporter changes (ETA 2d). 2) ravi: create aggregation job with 1m/5m windows and routing tags (ETA 3d). 3) liz: dashboard panels mock + panel queries tuned to rolled-up series (ETA 4d). 4) marco: run cost estimate + backfill plan (ETA 2d). 5) amanda: own rollout and canary plan, gate with telemetry signals (ETA 1w).

marco: I'll run a quick cost calc and post numbers. if anyone needs sample data for dashboard dev ping me, I'll generate synthetic.

amanda: thanks all. I'll kick off the telemetry-bot checklist and schedule a 30m sync if we need to close open questions. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Reminder: Scheduled maintenance window tomorrow 03:00-04:00 UTC may affect exporter rollouts.

ravi: noted — we'll avoid flipping global flags during that window. :eyes:
